verdict.rationale: Publishing source code under an open license is a fair question for a government digital service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows the Guichet unique's source being published or licensed. The free, publicly searchable registry and the keyless company-data API concern open data and access, not open source code, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
